We are the UK’s leading cat welfare charity. 
Scruffy cats. Shy cats. Stray cats. We’re here for all cats.  
Our videos help cat lovers understand their cats better. Our mission is to make a better life for cats, because life is better with cats. 

Cats.org.uk

Reg Charity 203644 (England and Wales) and SC037711 (Scotland)
